info.title: disc 0.1.2 — a command-line client for any Discourse forum.
info.description: A user-centric command line client for any Discourse instance. Read-first, with a browser-gated draft-only write path. Never publishes directly.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Read-first. The only write path is draft creation, which always hands off
to the browser for a human to publish. This tool never publishes directly
and is intended for interactive desktop use (not headless/CI runtime).

commands.name: draft
commands.description: Create a draft and open the browser to publish (§ write)

commands.name: login
commands.description: Authorize via the User API Key browser flow (read; --enable-drafts adds write)

commands.name: logout
commands.description: Remove the local credential for the target forum

commands.name: read
commands.description:
Read a topic (--topic <id>) or post (--post <id>) [--raw|--cooked]
categories List postable categories (--all includes read-only)

commands.name: skill
commands.description: Generate SKILL.md for the current forum (--output <path>)

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show current context, auth state, and scopes

commands.name: whoami
commands.description: Validate the stored credential and show the user
